method: Raw binary STL exact-coordinate weld only; whole-mesh crop intersections, unrounded sections and even-odd nesting; exact -0.4mm erosion on every positive component. No healing, rounding, island removal or thin exemption.

tests.feature: gap between rafters and inner bamboo
tests.note: Conservative small gap below the rafter underside and above the bamboo at x0–2. An initial z40–41 probe intersected the real rafter and was rejected; corrected probe is z39.1–39.55. No geometry removed. Does not claim entire roof underside is empty.

roof_translation: Alpha in Blend/3MF is not geometric air; opaque STL printing gives opaque roof. Roof patches are tested solid. Open sides and passage are tested as full empty volumes.
thin_warning: Steel .55×.65mm and longitudinal bamboo .76mm, roof .78mm, bamboo .86mm tangent slices, fine deck grooves and vent edges retain actual thin warnings. Scaling down can erase them. Horizontal erosion is not global normal thickness proof.
limitations: Approximate display geometry; no structural, bridge, supports, slicer-linewidth, accessibility or fabrication validation. Downward triangle area is not support material area or volume.
